title: AI Resume Analyzer and Job Matcher — End-to-End Evaluation Dataset
notes: Synthetic, manually labeled examples for development and regression testing.
The 30 role/profile cases cover ten roles with strong, mixed, and unrelated resumes.
Five adversarial cases cover React Native vs React.js, API evidence, MongoDB as partial NoSQL evidence, GitHub URL evidence, and ordinary 'express' wording.
Scores are not hiring probabilities or official ATS scores.
Review any failed case manually before changing production matching logic.
